remarks: MUST SEE!!! SPACIOUS & picturesque raised ranch that is completely MOVE-IN READY, attractively set on a double lot spanning over 0.69 acres backing to woods and the farmer’s field, surrounded by nature and located steps from the exquisite Spring Lake Winery while close to the Erie Canal. Featuring a bright & lovely kitchen w/wood cabinetry, recessed lighting, updated countertops, and desirable laminate flooring opening to the dining area & generous living room with arcadian wood crown molding. Step through the sliding glass doors and into the pristine, enclosed three-season room with an expansive rear wood deck overlooking the serene & generous backyard, perfect for sipping your morning coffee in your own private oasis. The main floor features three large bedrooms and a remodeled bath with dual vanity, vinyl shower surround, LVP flooring, and shiplap wall accents while the additional bedroom, half bath, and laundry rm downstairs with an expanded & attached 2.5 car garage makes for ease of living. With an open layout concept & an abundance of NATURAL LIGHT, this desirable home has a double wide asphalt driveway with parking area/turnaround & choice finishes throughout. Live worry free w/updates including a NEW sand filter septic system 2025, whole house Generac generator 2024, A/C & 3 season rm in 2023, high efficiency Carrier furnace 2022, windows 2021, arch. shingle roof 2020 and so much more. Meticulously maintained & very clean, this charming home rests on a PEACEFUL lot with low taxes, great schools & close to all conveniences! Showings begin 9/30/2026.
